description: Laddstationer och laddpunkter för elfordon i Tomelilla kommun is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Tomelilla kommun. The data set contains charging stations and charging points (also called charging poles) owned by the municipality that can be used for charging electric vehicles. Coverage: Tomelilla kommun. The portal shows the English title as "Charging stations and charging points for electric vehicles in Tomelilla Municipality" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Tomelilla kommun. Its keywords include Laddstationer, Laddstolpar, Laddpunkter, Elbil, Kommun, Laddning. The listing shows 3 download or service links in JSON, XLSX, HTML. The listing shows 2021-03-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
